productGoal: Help plant operators and supervisors carry unresolved conditions across a shift change with explicit acknowledgement, ownership, action, resolution evidence, and an updated operating record.

journeys: Observe shift pressure and open the highest-priority operating record.
Prepare an outgoing handoff and exercise invalid-field recovery.
Filter issue records, assign evidence, close or route approval, and export a shift brief.
Review shift pressure, filter issues, open a condition, validate a handoff, and inspect evidence-backed actions.
evidence: Responsive matrix reported scroll width equal to client width and no browser-console warnings; desktop and mobile screenshots were inspected.
